test_apply_out_of_range: test applying a pandas time offset to a timestamp and verify out-of-range datetime handling with timezone preservation
test_offsets_compare_equal: test two pandas offset instances of the same class compare as equal using equality operators
test_rsub: test subtracting a pandas offset from a timestamp equals negating the offset and applying it forward
test_sub: test subtracting a pandas offset from a datetime raises TypeError and verify offset arithmetic with multiplication
test_compare_str: test comparing a pandas offset instance to a string does not raise for equality or inequality operators
